tweets.text:
While robotics technology produces machines that perform physical tasks autonomously, automation enables processes to operate without human intervention. Robots capable of perceiving their surroundings and moving freely—thanks to artificial intelligence integration—are reshaping the future.

Konnex stands out by creating a neutral marketplace where robots can agree on tasks, license proven AI solutions on demand, and make payments for results using stablecoins. The system's components include a universal task language, market-priced AI, and a decentralized AI exchange that connects robot owners with AI developers under the supervision of validators. @konnex_world

The Konnex platform is designed to enable autonomous systems to accept tasks, generate proof of physical work, have results independently verified, and execute payments on-chain. Centered on Proof of Physical Work (PoPW), Konnex aims to transform robotic labor into verifiable economic activity, moving away from reliance on records controlled by the very operators running the machines.
